TelegramSession.title: TelegramSession
TelegramSession.description: Encrypted Telegram session and account credentials stored at rest for persistent cross-container restoration.

id.description: Document ID, e.g. account_0 or phone_xxx

accountIndex.description: The slot index of the account (0-3)

encryptedPayload.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted session string and tokens

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO format

ClientStorageBackup.title: ClientStorageBackup
ClientStorageBackup.description: Periodically backed up client localStorage state including tg_multi_accounts_v3, app_settings, and account preferences.

id.description: Backup document identifier (e.g. default_backup or userId)

storageData.description: JSON-serialized map of critical local storage keys including tg_multi_accounts_v3 and app_settings

keysSummary.description: Comma-separated list of keys included in the backup

backupTimestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the backup was produced

clientVersion.description: Client app version or user agent

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last Firestore update

/telegram_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores encrypted credentials and session strings for active Telegram accounts.

/client_storage_backups/{backupId}.description: Stores periodic snapshots of client localStorage keys (tg_multi_accounts_v3, app_settings) to prevent data loss on browser clear or device change.
